urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Pages to audit. A bare domain is accepted and https:// is assumed. Wire this to the output of a crawler Actor to audit a whole site.

timeoutMs.title: Request timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Per-URL fetch timeout. Slow pages beyond this are recorded as failed rather than stalling the run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages to fetch in parallel. Lower this when auditing many pages on one host so you do not trip rate limits.

userAgent.title: User agent
userAgent.description: Sent with every request. Some sites serve different markup to unknown agents.
